edge_cases: FUSED two-stage attention: QK^T then AV, two chained single-tile HMX matmuls
no softmax between stages (linear attention, documented design choice)
K packed with swapped tile indices for QK^T (K row j IS key vector j -- no transpose buffer)
intermediate score matrix Sc re-packed as the SECOND matmul's uint8 activation (input range pinned so Sc is always non-negative)
V already in the generic [K,N] matmul layout for stage 2 -- no index swap needed there
each stage clears its own HMX accumulator (mxclracc) and reuses the same VTCM addresses sequentially
input ranges pinned narrow so BOTH requant fields stay exact (no saturation) end to end
transposed-V near-miss (stage 2 packs V^T) must fail
name: i8_attention_qkt_av_hmx
